disk.title: Disk space
disk.lowSpace: Less than 1 GiB free — clean up before uploading
disk.stale: Stats are stale (not refreshed for over {{hours}}h)
disk.capThumbsOn: Server exposes /__lume__/thumb — grid images are resized server-side
disk.capThumbsOff: No thumbnail endpoint registered — thumbnails fall back to originals

toast.uploadCancelledNoClean: Upload cancelled, but the partial file could not be removed: {{msg}}
toast.sandboxDisabled: HTML preview sandbox turned off — re-enable it any time in Preferences

sandbox.bannerDetail: This HTML renders inside a browser sandbox: page scripts cannot reach your files on this site or your sign-in credentials. Turn the sandbox off only to browse a full static site that needs sibling resources.
sandbox.hintOn: HTML previews render in a sandbox by default, so page scripts cannot use your sign-in state.
sandbox.hintOff: Sandbox is off: HTML scripts run on this origin with your sign-in state. Only do this for files you fully trust.
sandbox.confirmBody: With the sandbox off, this page's JavaScript runs on {{host}} as the same origin, using your current sign-in state.
sandbox.confirmBullets: It can read, change and delete files in the gated area|It can send that content anywhere|The choice lives only in this browser — other devices keep the safe default
sandbox.reEnabled: HTML preview sandbox turned back on

thumbs.hintServer: The server advertises thumbnail support, so the grid uses server-rendered images.
thumbs.hintClient: No server thumbnail support, so the grid falls back to scaling the original in your browser (more bandwidth).
thumbs.hintAutoNoServer: This server has no thumbnail support, so nothing is shown now; pick “Always show” to fall back to browser-scaled originals.
thumbs.hintOff: Thumbnails are off by your choice — server capability changes will not re-enable them.
